messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) Calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: they were trapped by deers
You should choose Calm because Rebuke risks Emily panicking.
Here are the two options available: (A) rersist and (B) comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: the radio doesn't work
You should choose Persist because Comply risks the ranger not understanding you due to the weak radio signal.
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: the one who answar the radio request repeat
You should choose Persist because Inform risks the ranger not understanding you due to the weak radio signal.
Here are the two options available: (A) Suspicious and (B) Supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily is trapped and in panic
You should choose Suspicious because Supportive risks Emily panicking more and not taking decisive action.
Here are the two options available: (A) persistent and (B) concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: emily is panic and in danger
You should choose persistent because concerned risks delaying decisive action while Emily is panicked and in danger. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) insistent and (B) damanding. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: matt is questing emily and emily is in danger
You should choose insistent because demanding risks pushing Emily to shut down or panic, hindering Matt's ability to help her. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) insist and (B) concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: chirs doesn't trust goust
You should choose insist because conceding risks the ghost exploiting Chris's distrust and creating danger ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) dismissive and (B) sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: talking about hannah
You should choose dismissive because sympathetic risks triggering guilt and re-opening old tensions about Hannah, derailing the moment. ⚠️
Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: ashley is diciding if get into underground
You should choose reluctant because courageous risks rushing into the underground and facing the Psycho. ⚠️
